description: This file defines a report parser class for attendance error reports in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including methods to fetch attendance data and compute totals.

classes.name: attendance_print
classes.description: A report parser class for generating attendance error reports, providing methods to retrieve employee attendance data and calculate total durations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up local context with utility functions and data retrieval methods.

methods.name: _get_employees
methods.description: Fetches employee records based on provided employee IDs.

methods.name: _lst
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a specific employee within a date range, including delays and formatted durations.

methods.name: _lst_total
methods.description: Calculates total and partial attendance durations for an employee over a date range.
